fine_trace.note: source: attacker-controlled 'sfnt' type record supplies a non-zero resource-array offset (resourcesZ) pointing at a 12-byte ResourceRecord whose 24-bit data offset is 0xFFFFFF, far beyond the blob, so deep validation is doomed to fail.

root cause: resourcesZ is a null-enabled OffsetTo (has_null=true); when deep validation of the ResourceRecord array fails, neuter() zeroes the offset instead of rejecting the blob, and the second sanitize round then passes with 0 edits so the blob is accepted.
dataLen==0 makes the resource data block empty; the data offset stays fixed at 256 (the dfont tag value), so an OpenTypeFontFace formed at data_base+4 lands near the end of the 260-byte blob.
the first sfnt type record is selected (idx 0 < resCountM1+1); resourcesZ is now 0, so the resource record is resolved through the null branch.
the zeroed resourcesZ is null, so OffsetTo::operator() returns Null(UnsizedArrayOf<ResourceRecord>); the all-zero ResourceRecord yields offset24==0.

with offset24==0 (has_null=false so zero is not null), the forged OpenTypeFontFace header is formed at data_base+4 = 260; this header was never sanitized because the null resource record bypassed deep validation.
sink: loading the table count (BinSearchHeader.len, 2 bytes) of the forged header at 260+4=264; the read [264,266) crosses the 260-byte heap allocation -> heap-buffer-overflow read of size 2.

via: resourcesZ offset value (12) flows into OffsetTo::sanitize
deep validation of the ResourceRecord array fails because the record's 24-bit offset (0xFFFFFF) is out of range relative to data_base
neuter zeroes resourcesZ and the second sanitize round passes with 0 edits, so the blob is accepted
dataLen==0 leaves the data block empty so data_base (256) sits near the blob end
first table lookup (maxp/cmap) invokes _hb_face_for_data_reference_table on the accepted blob
get_face(0) scans the type list and selects the sfnt type record (idx 0 < resCountM1+1)
resourcesZ==0 is treated as null by OffsetTo::operator()
Null(UnsizedArrayOf<ResourceRecord>) yields an all-zero ResourceRecord with offset24==0
offset24==0 (has_null=false so zero is not null) resolves LArrayOf at data_base
CastR<OpenTypeFontFace> forms the forged, never-sanitized font header at data_base+4 (260)
get_table_by_tag reads the forged header's BinSearchHeader
2-byte tables.len read at 264 crosses the 260-byte allocation -> heap-buffer-overflow

vuln_logic.issue_alignment: OSS-Fuzz heap-buffer-overflow in the HarfBuzz dfont sanitizer: the first 'sfnt' type's resource-array offset (resourcesZ) is sanitized through a null-enabled OffsetTo; when deep validation fails the offset is zeroed and the blob is accepted, and the subsequent loading of the table count from the forged OpenTypeFontFace header reads past the end of the heap buffer.
